Hi Erin —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the S3 issue. We can absolutely accommodate a short extension. To keep this low-friction for procurement, I attached two files: a one-page amendment to the existing SOW (scoped-sow-acme-v1.pdf) and a pricing workbook (acme_pilot_pricing_v3.xlsx) that shows the concession options.

Proposal (short summary):
- Extension: +14 days to the current pilot window at no extra base charge.
- Concession: a one-time pilot credit equal to 20% of the projected pilot spend (applied as token/embedding credits) OR a staged discount schedule if you prefer invoice-based concessions:
  * Gate 1 (initial 10k tokens / 2 days): 5% discount applied to pilot invoice
  * Gate 2 (>=50k tokens / completion of embedding evaluation): 12% discount
  * Gate 3 (conversion to a Dedicated POC within 60 days): 20% credit applied toward first monthly invoice after conversion

Notes: the staged gates are intended to align cost with demonstrable progress; credits are applied retroactively on the pilot invoice once a gate is met. If procurement prefers a single-line credit we can do that too.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm which concession option procurement prefers (credit vs invoice discount).
2) I’ll send an addendum for signature (DocuSign link) and an updated invoice line for your PO team.

Attaching the files now — let me know if you want me to run the numbers with your estimated token volumes.

Best,
Priyom Das
